extension.name: plg_system_indieweb
extension.author: aftertaf
extension.description: IndieWeb identity, Micropub integration, Webmention metadata, and Bridgy Fed support.

field.name: hcard_name
field.label: Full Name
field.description: Your real or display name. Used in your h-card and author identity.

field.name: hcard_url
field.label: Profile URL
field.description: Your canonical homepage URL. Used as your primary IndieWeb identity.

field.name: hcard_photo
field.label: Photo URL
field.description: Square profile photo (recommended 512x512). Displayed in your h-card.

field.name: email
field.label: Email
field.description: Optional. Adds a mailto: link to your h-card. Publicly visible.

field.name: fediverse_handle
field.label: Fediverse Handle
field.description: Your ActivityPub username (e.g., @user@instance). Helps Bridgy Fed link identities.

field.name: hcard_note
field.label: Profile Note
field.description: Short bio or description included in your h-card.

field.name: relme
field.label: rel=me URLs
field.description: One URL per line. Used for identity verification across the IndieWeb and fediverse.

field.name: webfinger_username
field.label: WebFinger Username
field.description: Identity string for fediverse discovery (e.g., user@yourdomain.com).

field.name: webfinger_url
field.label: WebFinger LRDD URL
field.description: Advanced: Override the LRDD URL if needed. Usually leave default.

field.name: authorization_endpoint
field.label: Authorization Endpoint
field.description: IndieAuth authorization endpoint. Use indieauth.com unless self-hosting.

field.name: token_endpoint
field.label: Token Endpoint
field.description: IndieAuth token verification endpoint. Use tokens.indieauth.com unless self-hosting.

field.name: micropub_endpoint
field.label: Micropub Endpoint
field.description: URL of your Micropub server. Required for Micropub clients to create posts.

field.name: webmention_endpoint
field.label: Webmention Endpoint
field.description: URL of your Webmention receiver. Required for replies, likes, reposts, and Bridgy Fed.
